candidates.explanation: When no provider is passed, the user is saved with provider 'google'. AuthService.register (line ~201) calls usersService.create without a provider, so email-registered users get provider=google. Login then fails the check `user.provider !== AuthProvidersEnum.email` and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.
Register doesn't set provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly, so it relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email (and optionally pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register).
